title: Synthetic fixture: bright-field inspection
text:
This is invented software test material, not a technical publication.

In this fictional experiment, bright-field imaging detected surface scratches when they produced intensity contrast. Uneven illumination caused false detections. The experiment did not measure a minimum detectable defect size.

title: Synthetic fixture: dark-field inspection
text:
This is invented software test material, not a technical publication.

In this fictional experiment, dark-field imaging detected small surface defects through scattered light. Dust also scattered light and caused false positives. No comparison of detection accuracy against bright-field imaging was performed.

title: Synthetic fixture: learned anomaly detection
text:
This is invented software test material, not a technical publication.

In this fictional experiment, an anomaly detection model trained on defect-free surface images flagged unusual textures. A change in camera illumination reduced reliability. The experiment did not evaluate unseen material types or report inference latency.
